acquisition: Open Ephys ONIX via Bonsai; Neuropixels 2.0 (np2-a), 384 channels recorded on 2 shanks (x = 0/32 um and 250/282 um; y = 720-4005 um)

ephys.clock_file: np2-a-clock_2026-08-26T17_03_17.raw (uint64 tick per sample, first tick 466020 = 1.86 ms after clock start)

sort.curation: phy + bombcell; manual label column rf_label

video.camera_timestamps_file: camera_timestamps2026-08-26T17_03_17.csv (ns, camera device clock, one row per camera frame)
video.container_timestamps: synthetic constant-rate PTS in both raw and compressed MKV (verified by scanning block headers); drop positions unrecoverable
video.raw_writer: Lavf62.13.100 / h264_nvenc (Bonsai ffmpeg writer), DefaultDuration 16.768113 ms

sync.method: cross-correlation of video motion energy with good-unit population rate, 5-min blocks
sync.note: camera and ONIX clocks are independent; digital_inputs CSV has no timestamp column (Pin4 toggles 3094 times, identity unknown)

tracking.method: mouse_tracker.py: rolling-median background subtraction on the dark trunk, motion-scored candidate selection, position hold when resting; heading from direction of travel
tracking.video: cache/video_small/chunk_*.mp4 (crop x 90:2040, y 80:2040 of the original, scale 0.4, CLAHE)
tracking.wall_interfaces: empirical nose-reach polylines per wall (cache/wall_boundaries_session.json); top wall has a ~7 cm obstruction over its middle 25 cm
